summary: Background jobs failing with 403: service token scopes stripped by ADFS/proxy during token exchange in private deployment
description:
Issue summary:
Customers running Redwood Private (EdgeFin Analytics) report a sudden spike of 403s from internal background jobs that use service-account token exchange to perform tenant-scoped admin operations. Jobs started failing after an IdP certificate rotation and an upgrade to the corporate reverse-proxy in front of the customer's ADFS instance.

Impact:
- All scheduled model-management and dataset-ingestion jobs for EdgeFin are failing (no retries succeed).
- Customer is on a regulated cadence; missed jobs cause data staleness and SLA exposure.
- Affects only private deployment behind customer's ADFS+corporate proxy. Hosted customers unaffected.

Observed behavior:
- Token exchange succeeds (200) but the exchanged token presented to Redwood lacks the impersonation scope required (redwood:impersonate / act_as).
- Redwood authorizer rejects admin API calls with 403 "missing required scope: redwood:impersonate".
- SCIM / role bindings are correct; service account still has roles in our DB.

Environment details:
- Private deployment (EdgeFin) on-prem, prod-us-east.
- IdP: ADFS 4.0 behind a corporate reverse proxy (TLS termination + SNI rewrite).
- Recent changes: customer rotated IdP signing cert 2026-03-10 and upgraded proxy (adds request body normalization / form rewriting) 2026-03-11.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Configure a service account in customer's ADFS (SAML->OAuth exchange flow) with scope redwood:impersonate.
2) Use Redwood's token-exchange endpoint to exchange SAML assertion for a service token.
3) Present exchanged token to admin API (e.g., /admin/models/:id/rollout).
4) Observe 403 and validate token via /introspect shows missing scope claim.

Note: Repro is reliably seen only when requests are routed through the customer's proxy configured with request body/form normalization.
logs:
[2026-03-12T08:41:22Z] token-exchange: incoming_assertion=sha256:... status=200 asserted_scopes=[openid profile email]
[2026-03-12T08:41:22Z] token-service: issued_token=eyJ... scopes=[openid profile email]
[2026-03-12T08:41:22Z] authz: request=/admin/models/abc/rollout token=eyJ... scopes_missing=[redwood:impersonate] result=403 'missing required scope'
[Customer ADFS logs] 2026-03-11 22:41:21 POST /token assertion received; normalized form parameters; removed unknown parameter 'scope' during proxy rewrite
[Proxy logs] 2026-03-11 22:41:21 rewrite_engine: normalized body; dropped param 'scope' length=27
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: token claim mapping/SCIM mismatch. SCIM and role bindings verified OK.
- Confirmed token-exchange request includes scope parameter on initial client request to customer's IdP but final token returned to Redwood drops the custom 'redwood:impersonate' scope.
- Saw proxy logs from customer showing body normalization that strips unknown form keys (including 'scope') during POST to ADFS /token endpoint.
- Reproduced locally by placing a request body sanitizer in front of ADFS that removes unrecognized x-www-form-urlencoded keys. Tokens returned by ADFS in that path do not include the optional 'act_as' scope.
- Temporary mitigation: issuing tokens via direct call to IdP (bypassing proxy) returns token with proper scope and jobs succeed.
- Additional note: ADFS behavior after certificate rotation unchanged; change correlates with proxy upgrade.
resolution_notes:
- Short-term workaround provided to customer: Add a proxy rule to preserve 'scope' and other OAuth-related form parameters during POST to /token, or configure proxy to disable body normalization for the IdP path. Documented steps sent to EdgeFin support contact.
- Created a mapping fallback on the token-exchange service: if a returned token is missing expected impersonation scope but the request included an authenticated service-account assertion with a matching subject, accept the exchange and issue a service-scoped token (workaround toggle controlled by customer config). Controlled rollout planned.
- Engineering change: PR #418 adds optional assertion-scoped fallback in private-idp-proxy with strict audit logging; will ship to private-staging 2026-03-15.
- Follow-up: recommend adding pre-checks in Console to detect proxies that rewrite bodies (detect by comparing outgoing assertion payload vs returned token scopes).
comments: Maya Thompson (Customer Success) 2026-03-12: Customer escalated after 2 missed ingestion windows. Provided initial triage and asked for proxy logs.

EdgeFin SRE (Jordan Liao) 2026-03-12: Attached proxy logs showing 'rewrite_engine: normalized body; dropped param scope'. Confirmed proxy upgrade 2026-03-11.
Proposing to add passthrough rule for '/adfs/oauth2/token'.

Liam O'Connor (Eng - Auth) 2026-03-12: Investigated token-exchange flow. Confirmed missing scope in token introspection. Reproduced with local sanitizer. Marking as P1 Sev1.
Will prepare the fallback toggle and coordinate with infra for audit logs.
SRE (Oncall) 2026-03-13: Deployed temporary config in EdgeFin proxy (preserving 'scope'). Customer reports background jobs recovered. Keeping ticket open to track PR and longer-term fix.
